list: The official 55 PlayStation 5 trophies as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles, 2026-11-18. Names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's own words; every guide is written for this entry from those descriptions.

exophase.covers: Every trophy's official name, description and grade

psnprofiles.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
psnprofiles.covers: Grades, and the progress count PSN tracks where a trophy has one

own.name: Our own advice, from the official description
own.covers: The how-to: our reading of what the description asks for, not yet checked in the game

roadmap.title: Play the story
roadmap.note: Chapters 1-4, the named story missions and the final mission. Every chapter and mission trophy is unmissable: the story hands them to you as you play. While you play, watch for the flagged missables — the Missables view lists the moments to catch.

roadmap.title: Strangers and side strands
roadmap.note: The stranger strands open up as you explore: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret and Cal, plus the eight strands the silver trophy counts. Finish each strand's final mission. Check the map for stranger icons after every story chapter.

roadmap.title: Activities, collectibles and one-off feats
roadmap.note: The bulk of the list: stunts, the shooting range, races, fishing, the arcade, meditation, WAiNK spots, cards, vehicles, exploration — and the one-off feats. Work region by region and let the tracker keep count.

roadmap.title: The long grind and the platinum
roadmap.note: The slow earners — laundering, spending, garages, 100% completion — and then the platinum itself. By now the tracker shows exactly what is left; finish the last few and Vice Got a Price! is yours.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is the last trophy you earn: it unlocks the moment the other 54 are all checked off. There is nothing extra to do for it — work through the roadmap stages in order and it pops on its own. Use the tracker to see what is left; the long grinds in stage 4 are usually the last ones standing.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the opening mission, so this is the first trophy most players earn — just play the story from the start and it unlocks when the mission ends. Nothing to prepare and nothing to miss.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 of the story. Chapter trophies are unmissable: keep playing the main missions and this one arrives at the end of the chapter.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 of the story. Like the other chapter trophies it is unmissable — play the main missions through and it unlocks at the chapter's end.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 of the story. Keep following the main missions; the trophy unlocks when the chapter closes.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 of the story. The last chapter trophy before the finale — play the main missions through and it unlocks at the chapter's end.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story — the gold trophy for finishing the game. It unlocks when the credits roll on the last mission; there is no way to miss it, so enjoy the finale.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Story missions unlock in order as you play, so this one comes to you — finish the mission and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. A story mission like the rest: reach it in the main thread, finish it, and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Play the story until the mission appears, finish it, and the trophy is yours.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. A main-story mission — finish it when it comes up in the story and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. Reach it through the story, finish the mission, and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. A late story mission — finish it and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. This is the big one: every story mission, every stranger strand, every collectible set and every activity the game counts toward completion. It is the last gold most players earn, so treat it as the end of the roadmap — the tracker shows what is left across the other trophies, and most of what counts toward 100% is a trophy in its own right.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — the game's scored tricks: jumps, near misses, airtime and similar feats while driving or riding. They pile up during normal play, so do not grind them early; by the end of the story you will have a big chunk, then mop up the rest with a fast car and the ramps and jumps around Leonida. PSN tracks the count to 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once — nine activity types in all. Work through the activities list in the game (races, the shooting range, fishing, the arcade, bowling, meditation and the rest) and sample each one; a single try counts, no wins needed.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. This is a skill grind: visit the range, work through the challenges weapon by weapon, and replay any that fall short of gold. PSN tracks the count to 42.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 in all. Find each race location, win the drone race there, and move on; the trophy counts locations, not wins, so one win per spot is enough.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Variety matters more than volume: twenty distinct races, so spread your wins across the race types and locations rather than repeating one favourite.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is one of the stranger strands — follow his missions until the fishing challenge comes up, then out-fish him. Bring patience: fishing challenges reward steady reeling over speed.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet, pick a game and play it through to the end — any completed game counts.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's strand is one of the stranger missions — follow it through its missions until the final one, then finish it.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Follow Kenton's strand to its last mission and finish it.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Follow Billy's strand to its last mission and finish it.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. There are more strands than eight, so pick any eight and finish each one's final mission — the named strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret, Cal) plus any others you find count toward it.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Follow Randy's strand to its last mission and finish it.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Follow Tyrone's strand to its last mission and finish it.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots. Meditation spots are quiet places on the map; visit each one and meditate there. Work region by region so you do not lose track of which ones you have done.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand sends you after one particular animal — follow his missions until the hunt comes up, track the animal and take it down.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; collect full sets of three. Check shops, hideouts and the places the game marks — a set is only done when every card in it is found.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK is the game's photo-style check-in — use it at a hundred different spots. It adds up as you explore, so make it a habit at every new place you visit.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's side objectives — the counter climbs as you finish them across activities, combat and exploration. Keep an eye on the challenges list and clear the easy ones first.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. You need your partner with you when the heat is on: build a 4-star wanted level together, then break line of sight and stay hidden until it clears. The moment has to line up — partner present, four stars, clean escape — so plan it rather than hoping it happens.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Chain three shop robberies in one run with your partner, keeping the wanted level alive between them — do not let it clear. Pick three shops close together and move fast.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every new vehicle you get into counts — drive something different whenever you see it. Variety is the whole job: a hundred distinct vehicles across Leonida.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus slows time — trigger it with at least five enemies in range and drop them all before it ends. Set it up deliberately: find a group, start the focus, and work through them fast.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. VCIA is Vice City's airport — the trophy is about leaving it in a way the schedule never planned. The description does not pin down the exact move, so think like a smuggler: a runway, a stolen plane, no ticket.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Rhinos are the game's tanks — the trophy involves dealing with them, and the description keeps the details to itself. Expect heavy armour and heavier firepower; come prepared and watch for the moment.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Stealth is the whole job: get in, take the goods and get out without a single guard or camera catching you. Scout the store first, move quietly, and do not rush the exit.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Five vault jobs, each ending in a clean escape — the escape counts as much as the robbery. Plan the getaway before you go in.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck on its route, hit it, and escape with the take. The escape is part of the trophy, so have your route out ready.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — 52 areas. The map fills in as you travel; visit every named area until the whole state is uncovered. A long drive around the map with the tracker open is the simplest way to finish it.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — nine gangs. Each gang runs illegal operations somewhere in Leonida; hit one operation per gang. Keep a note of which gangs you have done so none gets missed.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. A quiet moment, not a mission: go to Ocean Beach, find the spot with the view, and have a cocktail. The description suggests a specific place and a specific mood — take your time when you get there.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Find a vehicle showroom, get a car inside it, and drive out through the glass the way the classics did. One big, loud exit is all it takes.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Bowling is one of the activities — visit the Kolt & Associates alley and bowl a proper game with a real follow-through. The trophy is about the moment, so play it straight.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description is deliberately vague — a partnership moment that plays to a crowd. Watch for the story or side moment where you and your partner are centre stage together.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PSN tracks a count to 500 — the choices you make across the game add up. Play through the story making decisions as they come; the counter climbs with every choice, so this one finishes itself over a full playthrough.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail something, then succeed on the second try — the trophy is about the comeback. The description does not say what, so it may be tied to a specific retry moment; if a mission or challenge goes wrong, try again right away.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Something strange is out there in Leonida — a weird event, a sighting, a moment that does not fit. Explore the odd corners of the map and pay attention when the game gets strange.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. A melee attack from a moving vehicle that knocks someone down — a drive-by, up close and personal. Line it up on a quiet road and swing as you pass.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies and jobs; launder them through your contacts until a quarter of a million is clean. It is a slow earner — keep laundering as you play and it finishes late.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Shopping counts: clothes, weapons, cars, food — every dollar across every shop adds up. Spend steadily and the trophy arrives on its own.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — eight in all. Garages are properties you buy; own all eight and the trophy pops. Save for the expensive ones last.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Scooter Bros app takes vehicle registrations — register ten different vehicles through it.
